messages:
megan: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — we sketched a bunch of remediation tasks but didn't lock owners or timelines. Can folks ack ownership for the regional failover items and propose ETAs?

daniel: Ack. I'll take the multi-region routing policy changes. ETA EOW for a first PR, aiming for config + canary. :thumbsup:

priya: I can own backups verification + restore checklist updates. Need a small helper to validate snapshot retention windows across regions. ETA next Tue (2026-03-31). :calendar:

megan: priya — can you add the specific verification commands to the runbook? put them under "restore-preflight" so runbook tests can be automated later.

priya: Will do. Draft snippet below and push to runbook repo.
```bash
# check latest snapshot for prod DB
gcloud compute snapshots list --filter="labels=redwood-prod" --sort-by=~creationTimestamp | head -n 5
# validate retention label
gcloud compute snapshots describe SNAPSHOT_ID --format="value(labels.retention)"
```

sylvia: I'll take ownership of the restore runbook step that boots a warm standby and validates KV cache priming. ETA 1 week. I want to add an automated smoke test after KV prime. :eyes:

marco: For routing, daniel and I should sync — I'll handle traffic shaping playbook and traffic-splitting config. Suggest a canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on latency > 200ms. ETA Weds.

mei: Noted. I'll coordinate the game-day window and staffing. Proposed slot: Thu 2026-04-07 09:00 PT (3h). Can everyone confirm availability? :spiral_calendar:

alex: I can run the chaos run for region failover during the game-day (network partitions + control plane degrade). Need a recovery runbook dry-run beforehand. ETA for dry-run: 2026-04-02.

megan: Good. Let's capture actions in a concise ACTION list so we can track and hand off in the sprint.

priya: ACTION: priya - backups verification across eu/us/ap-south, add preflight commands to runbook, doc expected by 2026-03-31.

sylvia: ACTION: sylvia - implement KV priming + smoke test into restore runbook, PR by 2026-04-01.

marco: ACTION: marco - traffic shaping playbook + split config, coordinate with daniel, PR by 2026-03-25.

daniel: ACTION: daniel - routing policy changes and canary automation, open PR + test harness by 2026-03-26.

alex: ACTION: alex - chaos run script + dry-run ops checklist, ready by 2026-04-02.

mei: ACTION: mei - schedule game-day, create staffing rota, confirm participants list by 2026-03-28.

ops-bot: Reminder queued: create JIRA epics for each ACTION and ping owners daily until resolved.

megan: Can someone volunteer to own the cross-regional backup test ticket in JIRA? I want a single tracking epic.

priya: I'll create the epic and link the backup tasks under it. I'll post the ticket number here once created.

priya: FYI created EPIC-5421 "cross-region backup & restore validation" and linked tasks.

sre-oncall: Quick note — during last failover the internal DNS TTLs caused a ~2m lag for some services. Add a remediation item: lower critical service TTLs to 30s during the game-day and put them back after. ACTION: alex + daniel to add automation.

megan: Nice catch. Adding: ACTION: alex + daniel - temporary TTL automation for game-day, ready by 2026-04-05.

marco: Also worth tracking recurring pattern: we've seen routing misconfig + snapshot lag combo twice now. Propose a small monthly DR smoke to catch regression. ACTION: marco - propose cadence + checklist.

megan: OK that's everything I wanted to capture here. I'll convert this thread into a quick handoff doc and ping owners. Please update EPIC-5421 as you make progress. :white_check_mark:

priya: acked and will update checkpoints after pushing runbook changes.

sylvia: ack. Will PR tests to runbook repo and add smoke step.

ops-bot: Assigned tasks created in JIRA: EPIC-5421 -> TASK-1172, TASK-1173, TASK-1174, TASK-1175. Owners: priya, sylvia, marco, alex.

megan: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks you, drop it here and we'll reassign.
